server.name: community-groundwork
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 598 of Frame 3, block 5. Five tools, none annotated. Two of them write into a repository directory, seeded empty in the trial root: scaffold_harness runs `groundwork init`, and check_readiness runs `groundwork check` against the scaffolded harness. The two check tools that take answers and records in the call are not exercised. Each check writes one results file under groundwork/results named by the millisecond it ran; two clean runs differed in that name and in the file's top-level timestamp and nowhere else, so that directory is observed as a tally with timestamp declared away.

fixtures.note: Scaffolds the document-qa harness into an empty repository directory.
Runs the readiness check on a freshly scaffolded harness. The fixture prelude scaffolds it; it calls a different tool and takes no fault.
